I sent the first one on Monday and I did not receive an answer, so this is a follow-up. The situation is simple. One person in my team leaves on the thirtieth, and I need the approval for the replacement before the end of the week. If the problem is the information I sent, tell me. I can send it again in a shorter form, with the cost in one line and the start date in another. Please get back to me when you can. Thank you.
